description: React component for a tag context menu in a web application, providing options like favorite, add subtag, rename, delete, and displaying tag metadata.

classes.name: TagContextMenu
classes.description: React functional component for displaying a context menu for tags, with options to favorite, add subtags, rename, delete, and show metadata.

methods.name: onClickAddSubtag
methods.description: Handles adding a subtag; activates premium modal if not entitled, otherwise sets state to add subtag.

methods.name: handleIconChange
methods.description: Updates the icon of the selected tag.

methods.name: onClickStar
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of the tag.
